sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and an impressive recent record of five wins and one draw, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Alsager arrive in poor form with just one win in their last six matches and sit bottom of the division with only 4 points, making this a fixture where Sandbach will be strong favourites to extend their lead at the summit.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a tricky away trip to Dawley Town, who have won two of their last three; this clash could prove pivotal in the title race given Stafford's recent draw. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth travel to Eccleshall in what represents a recovery opportunity for the hosts after their recent loss, while second-place contender Wolverhampton Casuals host fellow top-half side Wednesfield Community. Bilston Town (6th) visit Foley Meir (13th) in a mid-table encounter, and Barnton welcome Shawbury United—the latter enduring a dire run of five consecutive defeats. The bottom-of-the-table clash sees Widnes Town, pointless in recent matches, away at Brereton Social (11th), while Telford Town travel to Cheadle Heath Nomads in a fixture between two struggling sides. Market Drayton Town host New Mills—both mid-table sides seeking consistency—and Crewe entertain Allscott Heath in a match between teams competing in the lower reaches of the division.
